decisions.reason: As a core door-handle family with visible development and catalogue commitment, management would likely keep it and attribute any slower uptake to long architectural specification cycles rather than admit an early launch mistake.
This mitred handle family remains closely tied to the firm's design-led architectural hardware positioning, so sunk design and launch investments plus public portfolio commitment favor retention.

Because the multifunctional handle supports the firm's announced barrier-free and system-solution direction, management would be especially reluctant to withdraw it and would justify patience on the basis of gradual market adoption.

Another handle family in the firm's established competence area is likely to be maintained, since the firm has already invested in tooling, promotion and specification support and can still view any weak results as temporary market conditions.
